scalars.scalar_value: Ability to sweep, dust mop, polish and perform semi-skilled housekeeping and general maintenance duties of hanging blinds and draperies which require a greater degree of skill, training, independence of action & physical effort and experience.

items.item_text: Valid California driver’s license.
Background Check and Live Scan
Employment Misconduct
Legal Right to work in the United States
Vaccination Policies
Smoking and Tobacco Policy
Drug Free Environment
California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act
E-Verify
Pre-Placement Health Evaluation
High school diploma or equivalent certification.

Ability to sweep, dust mop, polish and perform semi-skilled housekeeping and general maintenance duties of hanging blinds and draperies which require a greater degree of skill, training, independence of action & physical effort and experience.
Custodial or related cleaning experience.

Under the supervision of the Custodial or Assistant Custodial Supervisor, the incumbent performs skilled and semi-skilled cleaning, housekeeping, and/or general maintenance duties for most of their time which requires a greater degree of training, skill, independence of action, physical effort and experience than found at the custodial level. Incumbents will operate pressure washers, carpet extraction machines and other equipment required to maintain the facilities in Student Housing. Assignments could include residence halls or apartments, occupied or unoccupied units, common areas/buildings and/or exterior locations. Responsible for the setup and take down of special equipment and furniture. Ability to read, write and speak English to directly communicate with staff and students. Incumbent is responsible for security and maintenance of master keys and assigned equipment. Required to drive a motorized cart and University vehicle to complete job duties. Work may include evenings, weekends and overtime.
Operate a motor vehicle.

Available for overtime and weekend work. Work schedules are subject to change to meet department’s needs. Department can require overtime work to meet operational needs. Department can operate and assign custodial shifts seven days a week.
Must be able to communicate in English – both verbally and in writing – for purpose of instruction and record keeping.
Must be able to climb stairs and ladders.
Must be able to pass background check.
Must be willing and able to respond to after-hours emergencies.
Must be willing and able to assist in the event of a disaster.
Must be able to lift and carry loads over 50 lbs.
Skill to operate pressure washers, vacuum cleaners, buffers, wet/dry vacs, carpet shampooers and other floor care equipment.
Ability to follow, model and promote conduct that adheres to the University of California Principles of Community.
Ability to work as part of a team and serve as the work leader for a small group of custodians, temporary staff or student staff.
Ability to read and write English to submit written reports and work orders .
Basic knowledge of cleaning chemicals.
